requirements.requirement_text: FR-01: Policyholders and agents can report a new claim (FNOL) through a responsive web and mobile experience.
FR-02: FNOL accepts photos and documents of up to 25 MB per file, with a virus scan before storage.
FR-03: The triage service assigns each new claim a severity score and a recommended handling route.
FR-07: Adjuster workbench with configurable work queues, diary tasks and supervisor dashboards.
FR-08: FNOL available in English and Spanish.
FR-09: Conversational assistant that answers 'where is my claim?' questions on the web and by SMS.
NFR-01: Hosted on Microsoft Azure in United States regions only. No claims data outside the United States.
NFR-02: FNOL availability of 99.9% per calendar month, excluding agreed maintenance windows.
NFR-03: The vendor holds a current SOC 2 Type II report covering the services proposed.
NFR-06: Data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2 or higher) and at rest with customer-managed keys.
